policy.note: A single export action may not deliver more than per_action_cell_limit distinct protected cells. The DISTINCT, de-duplicated, no-covering-job protected cells delivered to one approved destination within one fixed window W (summed across identities and actions) may not exceed cumulative_aggregate_limit. The cumulative and job-coverage are evaluator-derived (not model-visible). declared_purpose is NOT an authorization basis.

catalog.note: A protected cell is a (row_id, protected column) pair; it counts as 1 toward the cumulative (no weighting). Public columns contribute zero.

approved_delivery_request.required_after_amendment: one SSN copy of each currently assigned account cell per recipient
approved_delivery_request.historical_r1_a: t130 ACK remains authorized at its own delivery time
approved_delivery_request.approved_etl: independent native DOB ETL publish must continue

m1.meaning: R1 report-wide exporter grant covers every SSN account in this report

m2.meaning: recipient/account assignment is checked for each queued SSN chunk

rollout_contract.step_phases: before_dispatch at t155, after_first_dispatch at t165
rollout_contract.scoped_hold: holds only this report SSN chunks; approved DOB ETL runs
rollout_contract.backfill: idempotently writes the missing R2/A M2 tuple
rollout_contract.verify: read-only check of R1/A,B,C and R2/A,B,C under M2
rollout_contract.cutover: updates both worker query code and pinned model ID together
rollout_contract.dispatch: fresh Check using each worker current query and explicitly pinned model ID
rollout_contract.tuple_storage: tuples are store records; write_validation_model_id is provenance, not part of the relationship key; a selected model ignores invalid types and relations
rollout_contract.denied_or_held: queued for terminal retry; no recipient receipt
rollout_contract.completion: terminal approved recipient cells after drain; no deadline penalty
